_comment: Pre-filters which job postings even reach (paid) AI scoring. include_keywords: a title needs ONE of these substrings (lowercased) to pass. exclude_keywords: any match here rejects the title outright, checked BEFORE include_keywords. whole_word_keywords: like include_keywords but matched as a whole word (regex \b), for short words that would false-positive as a substring (e.g. 'data' inside 'database'). remote_required: true rejects any posting with hybrid/onsite language before it reaches scoring (the hard-cut default); set false if you're open to hybrid/onsite -- those roles will still reach scoring, where scoring_rules.md can express a softer preference instead of a hard rejection. Copy this file to config/title_filters.json and edit for YOUR target titles.
